---
name: Intern Task
about: Standard task template for Hackathon Radar Finder
title: "[TASK] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Task ID

Example:
BE-001
SCR-001
AI-001
FE-001
DB-001

## Objective

Clearly describe what needs to be completed.

## Assigned Module

Example:

backend/app/api/routes/
backend/scraper/
backend/ai/
backend/data/
frontend/

## Files to Work On

List the expected files or folders.

## Expected Output

Describe exactly what should be produced.

Example:

- Working API endpoint
- Scraper returning standardized records
- Prediction model output
- Frontend page
- Automated tests

## Branch Name

Use:

feature/TASK-ID-short-name

Example:

feature/SCR-001-devpost

## Acceptance Criteria

- Code runs without errors
- Follows existing project structure
- Uses common schemas where applicable
- Tested locally
- No secrets committed
- No unrelated files changed
- Pull Request created into develop

## Testing Required

Explain how the intern should test the task.

## Pull Request Requirements

PR must include:

- Task completed
- Files changed
- Testing performed
- Sample output or screenshot
- Known limitations
- Related issue number

## Notes

Add any additional instructions here.
